wind_speed = df['wind_speed']

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient and p-value
r_value, p_value = pearsonr(pressure, wind_speed)

print(f"\nPearson Correlation Analysis:")
print(f"Raw r-value: {r_value}")
print(f"Raw p-value: {p_value}")

# Round the values according to specifications
r_rounded = round(p_value, 2)  # r-value rounded to 2 decimal places

# Determine significance
alpha = 0.05
if p_value < alpha:

else:

print(f"\nFormatted Results:")
print(f"Correlation coefficient (r): {r_rounded}")
print(f"P-value: {p_rounded}")
print(f"Relationship significance: {significance}")

# Create the final answer in the required format
answer = f"@correlation_coefficient[{r_rounded}] @p_value[{p_rounded}] @relationship_significance[{significance}]"
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {answer}")
